NDT software in Milwaukee: a manufacturing-led inspection market

Milwaukee's NDT market is built on manufacturing more than on process plants. The metro area has a long history of foundries, forge shops and heavy-equipment builders: Komatsu's mining equipment operations in the Harbor District, Caterpillar's mining machinery plant in South Milwaukee, A.O. Smith's water heater and boiler business, Regal Rexnord's power transmission products and Harley-Davidson, plus a long tail of job shops, gear makers and fabricators across Waukesha, Washington and Racine counties. That means a large share of inspection happens in a lab or on a shop floor: MT and PT on castings and weldments, UT on forgings and plate, RT and computed radiography on castings, hardness and PMI for material verification, all under the supplier quality requirements of the OEM that bought the part.

Field work fills out the rest. We Energies' Oak Creek and Port Washington generating stations and NextEra's Point Beach nuclear plant near Two Rivers run spring and autumn outages. The Great Lakes shipyards at Sturgeon Bay and Marinette build and repair vessels under classification-society survey. Port Milwaukee, bridges and water infrastructure add structural and pipeline jobs, with winter weather pushing much field work into the warmer months. Wisconsin is an NRC Agreement State, so radioactive materials licensing runs through the Department of Health Services radiation protection program, and boilers and pressure vessels fall under the Department of Safety and Professional Services. The typical Milwaukee NDT business is either a contract lab serving manufacturers, with a small field crew, or an in-house NDT department inside a manufacturer that needs the same controls as an independent lab.

ERP for NDT companies in Milwaukee

The Atlantis ERP solution is a fully customized ERP for NDT and inspection companies. It covers technician certifications, procedures, equipment calibration, crew dispatch, NDT reports, quoting, timesheets and invoicing in one system, and for a Milwaukee lab it replaces the job travellers, calibration binders and cert spreadsheets that a supplier auditor picks apart.

Atlantis NDT, founded by ASNT NDT Level III Anoop Rayavarapu, configures the ERP around your methods, your customers' report and traceability requirements and your billing, and supports it after go-live. It is browser-based with an offline field app for outage and shipyard crews. The positioning is affordable, accessible and fully customizable, with a demo and quote on request. See all modules on the ERP apps page.

NDT reporting software for castings, forgings and weldments

The NDT Reports app provides 17 report types, each with its own numbering sequence: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday testing and computed radiography. Reports go through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures.

For Milwaukee lab work the method-specific fields line up with what OEM customers check. MT reports record technique and particle type, whether wet fluorescent on a bench unit or dry powder with a yoke. PT reports record method and developer. RT reports capture source, technique and IQI type and placement, and computed radiography has its own report type for labs that have moved away from film. UT reports carry the probe calibration table, PAUT records focal laws, and hardness, PMI and ferrite each have their own report type. Job lines record defect type and orientation, and each report closes with acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks, with work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing, procedure and standard references captured.

Customers often supply their own certification forms. Versioned templates in Excel, Word, PDF and HTML handle that, with Excel templates filled automatically by mapping fields to cells. See the NDT Reports app and Digital Twin Reporting Software.

Technician certification tracking software for Milwaukee labs and crews

The Certificates app records each technician's certifications by scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level, method, certifying body, industry sector and dates, and computes active, expiring soon, expired or revoked status automatically, with warning tasks 90 days ahead of expiry.

Manufacturer labs in Milwaukee tend to grow their own technicians, bringing trainees up through Level I and II under an SNT-TC-1A written practice. The ERP records OJT hours and training hours against each certification, and certificate templates per scheme define validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required and the minimum OJT and training hours, so the Level III can see who is ready to test. Examination sheets hold general, specific and practical scores against a configurable passing score, with exam files attached. Vision tests, including Jaeger J1/J2 near vision, far vision, colour perception and contrast, are tracked with examiner, clinic and expiry, which matters in a fluorescent MT or PT booth where colour and contrast perception are part of the job.

The employee NDT profile also stores radiation safety training, radiation badge number and medical fitness expiry for radiographers. Configurable daily email alerts cover technician certs, calibration certificates and company certifications such as your quality system registration. See the Certificates app.

Calibration management software for Milwaukee NDT labs

Asset Management tracks every instrument and accessory by serial number: bench MT units, yokes, UV lamps, flaw detectors, hardness testers, PMI analysers, probes and CR equipment, with lifecycle status, condition, firmware, accessories, calibration frequency and next due date. Calibration records capture provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag and result.

A supplier quality audit usually starts with calibration: show me the certificate for this yoke, this light meter, this hardness tester, and show me which jobs it was used on. The calibration certificate register holds each lab's accreditation number, valid, expiring or expired status and the PDF, with expiry alerts. Invoice and timesheet lines carry equipment serial numbers, which ties instruments to jobs. The maintenance log records preventive and corrective work, cleaning, firmware updates and probe replacements with condition before and after. Consumables, which in a lab include penetrant, developer, MT bath concentrate, cleaners and PPE, carry reorder levels, low-stock flags and a movement ledger. Purchase records vendor types including calibration labs with accreditation number and expiry. See Asset Management and Purchase.

Procedures and customer approvals

The Procedures app keeps your written procedures with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard, acceptance criteria and text or file. Revisions go through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with locked approved revisions, rejection reasons and a snapshot of every revision.

Milwaukee OEMs frequently require their suppliers' NDT procedures to be submitted and approved before production parts are inspected, and to be resubmitted after each revision. The revision history and dated approvals make that exchange much easier to manage. Approvers receive email reminders, and an AI-assisted first draft speeds up a new procedure such as a casting-specific PT procedure, always reviewed and approved by a Level III. See the Procedures app.

Crew dispatch software for outages and shipyard work

Team Assignments runs field jobs as dispatch records through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed, blocks double-booking of technicians and equipment serial numbers, and warns if assigned equipment is out of calibration.

Milwaukee firms that split people between the lab and the field feel the scheduling squeeze during spring and autumn outages, when a power plant and a shipyard both want crews while production customers still need parts inspected. The technician availability calendar holds assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days with overlaps blocked, and each technician shows current assignment, utilisation percentage and next available date. Mobilisation and demobilisation dates and site GPS coordinates are recorded on each assignment. For shipyard work, the marine mode in NDT Reports adds a vessel cover page and merges the classification-society certificate, the inspector's Level II cert and the calibration certificate into the PDF. See Team Assignments.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for Milwaukee contractors

Quotations include job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, NDT service products by method and category, a global discount, a branded PDF and online acceptance that converts into a sales order. Invoices carry project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals.

Lab work for manufacturers is repetitive: the same part numbers, the same methods, week after week, often against a blanket PO. Setting up NDT service products by method and category keeps those quotes consistent, and invoice lines by cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician and hours or days keep them traceable. Field jobs use timesheets with work type (inspection, travel, standby, setup), method, site, client, equipment serial, billable flag, overtime multiplier and approval feeding billing. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over twelve months, which helps when lab and field margins behave very differently. See Quotations and Invoicing.

Training trainees with eLearning

Because Milwaukee labs often develop technicians internally, the eLearning app is useful: a course portal with Level I, II and III sections, protected video lessons, quizzes that can be imported from Word files, certificates of completion and a learner dashboard. Atlantis provides SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training, and the Practical NDT 3D simulator gives trainees hands-on practice between shifts.

Inspection management software in Milwaukee: implementation

Implementation is remote and planned around your production and outage calendar. It starts with discovery of your methods, customers, traceability requirements and billing; imports technicians, certificates, vision tests, equipment and calibration certificates from spreadsheets; rebuilds report and quotation templates, including customer certification forms; and connects other systems through the open REST API, which integrates with QuickBooks, NetSuite, SAP, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Anything specific to your lab that is not built in is configured during implementation. Ask for a Milwaukee implementation plan.

What to ask in an NDT ERP demo in Milwaukee

Milwaukee NDT work is heavy on manufacturing: foundries, heavy equipment makers, lab testing and power generation. Volume is steady and repetitive, so small savings per job add up. Ask the vendor to prove those savings on screen.

  • Show a repeat inspection order for a foundry customer created from the last one in a few clicks.
  • Show lab and field technicians tracked in one certificate register with expiry warnings.
  • Show report templates for castings and for welds, each with the right acceptance standard field.
  • Show monthly invoicing for a customer with many small jobs, grouped on one statement.
  • Show trainee progress through eLearning toward certification.

Request a Milwaukee demo on your own jobs.

Frequently asked questions

What is the best NDT software for a Milwaukee NDT lab?

A lab serving manufacturers needs traceability from part to technician to instrument to procedure revision. The Atlantis ERP links those records and produces reports in your customers' formats.

Can it be used by an in-house NDT department inside a manufacturer?

Yes. Certificates, procedures, calibration and reports work the same for an in-house department; billing apps can be left off or used for internal cost centres, configured during implementation.

Does it track OJT hours for trainees?

Yes. OJT and training hours are recorded per certification and checked against minimums set in certificate templates per scheme.

Which report types suit casting inspection?

MT, PT, RT, computed radiography, UT, VT, hardness and PMI are all built-in report types with method-specific fields.

Will it connect to our manufacturing or accounting system?

Yes, through the open REST API with SAP, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Maximo or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.

How is it priced?

Quote on request. Ask for a quote.
